correctness.rationale: The distance formula is exact for Boolean zero-divisor graphs. A complete size-based case analysis shows every vertex pair has at least three middle-layer distinguishers except complementary middle vertices, which have exactly two. Therefore deleting two middle landmarks fails precisely when those landmarks are complementary. Exhaustive checks for n=6 and n=8 and arithmetic checks of the lower bounds agree with the proof.
